test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Mr. Cook sold a book at a profit of 14%. If he had sold it for Rs. 5.40 more, then he would have made a profit of 20%. Find the cost price of the book.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 90.**__
